nodes.title: Preserve canonical screen/action meaning and source authority
nodes.detail: Keep stable graph screen/action meaning canonical and record source authority by fact. Add annotations to the existing meaning; do not replace graph relationships or choose one global authority for every fact.

nodes.title: Keep readable purpose and behavior grounded in source
nodes.detail: Human-readable annotations may describe purpose, journey, first action, behavior, precondition, result, and failure/limits only when supported by the source; do not invent missing conditions or outcomes. Include source-backed summaries and Figma/web scope when present; organize full body copy into labeled sections.

nodes.title: Separate internal verification and ownership metadata
nodes.detail: Keep technical prefixes, hashes, target ownership, and verification state separately identifiable from human-readable body copy and artwork; preserve their non-overlap.

nodes.title: Pin graph-to-display updates to fresh target readback
nodes.detail: Trace each graph specification through display update to actual target readback, with graph hash/revision, target identity, and freshness; stale getters cannot count as current.

nodes.title: Preserve IDs, paths, annotations, replay, and rollback
nodes.detail: Preserve semantic IDs, paths, design/user annotations, replay inputs, legacy-prefix identity, idempotent updates, conflict handling, and rollback behavior.
